title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Graduation: After Three Years of an Honours Degree Program
Students
in honours BA and BSc
programs
will be allowed to graduate with a
general degree without a major (or any other
designation
), if they meet the following requirements:
having met the progression requirements for their program, they are eligible to enter Year 4 of their honours program
all the courses normally constituting the first three years of their honours program are successfully completed
a minimum of 15.0 credits are successfully completed.
Students eligible to enter Year 4 of an honours program may elect to receive a general degree with the major of their honours program (if applicable in that major), subject to meeting requirements of that general degree. Minimum
GPA
requirements must be satisfied, a minimum of 6.0 credits in the honours major (5.0 senior) must have been completed, and a minimum of 15.0 credits are required.
